headline: 31 October 2026: Ethereum tops TVL at $43.9bn; USDT leads stablecoins
summary: Ethereum holds the largest chain TVL at $43.9bn, followed by Bitcoin at $6.1bn and Base at $5.8bn. Uniswap V4 recorded the highest 24h DEX volume at $1.33bn while Tether generated the top fees at $16.9m. USDT circulation stands at $179.6bn and USDC at $71.9bn, with several stablecoins showing peg deviations. Multiple security incidents occurred in the prior 14 days, including a $6.36bn event at Binance CEX.
